name: Dark Elves
source: Warhammer Armies: Dark Elves (4th edition, 1995), army list pp.46-55, special characters pp.56-63 (book page numbers)
keywordsSource: Special rule keywords from the Dark Elf bestiary (pp.33-43) and army list

rules.message: The army must be led by one General (p.49).
Only one Battle Standard is allowed (p.49).
Up to one Reaper Bolt Thrower per regiment of ten or more Warriors, Spearmen, Crossbowmen, City Guard or Corsairs (p.54).

entries.name: Dark Elf General
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.name: Battle Standard Bearer
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Re-roll break tests within 12"
entries.notes: His one magic item may be a magic standard (p.49).

variants.name: Witch Elf Hero
variants.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Frenzy, Poisoned weapons (+1 S)

entries.name: Dark Elf Sorcerer

variants.name: Sorcerer
variants.rulesText: Level 1 wizard, Masters of Dark Magic, Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

variants.name: Champion Sorcerer
variants.rulesText: Level 2 wizard, Masters of Dark Magic, Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

variants.name: Master Sorcerer
variants.rulesText: Level 3 wizard, Masters of Dark Magic, Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

variants.name: Sorcerer Lord
variants.rulesText: Level 4 wizard, Masters of Dark Magic, Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.notes: Wearing armour prevents a Sorcerer casting spells (p.50).

entries.name: Dark Elf Assassin

attachTo.label: Hidden in
attachTo.requiredMessage: an Assassin must be hidden in a regiment of Dark Elf infantry

entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Disguise, Always strikes first, Poison (D3 wounds)
entries.notes: Any regiment of Dark Elf infantry may include a single Assassin (p.50).

entries.name: Cold One Knights
entries.equipmentText: Sword, heavy armour, shield, Cold One
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Fear, Stupidity (Cold Ones)

entries.name: Executioners of Har Ganeth
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Expert axemen (D3 wounds)

entries.name: Dark Riders
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Skirmish, Special deployment, Expert riders, Fire and flee
entries.notes: The book prices spears at +2 per model for Dark Riders (p.51).

entries.name: Black Guard of Naggaroth
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.name: Dark Elf Crossbowmen
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.name: Dark Elf Warriors
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.name: Dark Elf City Guard
entries.equipmentText: Spears or repeating crossbows, light armour

options.name: Models with repeating crossbows instead of spears

entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Combined formation
entries.notes: Each model has a spear (11) or a repeating crossbow (+2); enter how many carry crossbows. The Champion is priced with a spear (p.52).

entries.name: Witch Elves
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Frenzy, Poisoned weapons (+1 S)

entries.name: Dark Elf Scouts
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Skirmish, Special deployment, No rocky/hilly terrain penalty

entries.name: Black Ark Corsairs
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Sea Dragon Cloak (5+ save, not modified by Strength)
entries.notes: A Corsair Champion must have a Sea Dragon cloak for +5 points (p.50). Repeating crossbows cost +3 per model for Corsairs (p.53).

entries.name: Dark Elf Spearmen
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests

entries.name: Harpies
entries.rulesText: Fly, No obedience tests
entries.notes: Harpies never have champions, standard bearers or musicians and cannot be led by characters (p.54).

entries.name: Cauldron of Blood
entries.equipmentText: Keeper and Guardians: two swords each, light armour
entries.rulesText: Witch Elves within 18" triple attacks in first round, 6+ magical save for Witch Elves within 18"
entries.notes: The Keeper may not carry magic items (p.54).

entries.name: Reaper Bolt Throwers
entries.rulesText: Single shot (48", S5 -1 per rank, D4 wounds) or multiple shot (S4)

entries.name: War Hydra
entries.rulesText: Terror, Breathe fire, Scaly skin (5+)

entries.name: Malekith, the Witch King of Naggaroth
entries.equipmentText: Sword, Spellshield, Destroyer, Witch King's Armour, Circlet of Iron; scythed Black Chariot pulled by two Cold Ones
entries.rulesText: Level 4 wizard, Immune to psychology, Fear, Witch King's Armour (-1 to hit him)
entries.notes: 350 points plus Circlet of Iron 50, Witch King's Armour 60, Spellshield 50, Destroyer 75 and the Black Chariot 90 (p.56). If used he is the army's General.

entries.name: Beastlord Rakarth of Karond Kar
entries.equipmentText: Sword, Armour of Fortune (heavy armour), Enchanted Shield, Whip of Agony; rides a Black Dragon
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Beastlord
entries.notes: 134 points plus Whip of Agony 25, Armour of Fortune 15, Enchanted Shield 5 and the Black Dragon 450 (p.58).

entries.name: Morathi, the Hag Sorceress
entries.equipmentText: Sword, Dark Sword, Amber Amulet, Power Scroll, Dispel Magic Scroll; rides the Dark Pegasus 'Sulephet'
entries.rulesText: Level 4 wizard (Dark Magic or Slaanesh spells), Hate High Elves, Obedience tests
entries.notes: 327 points plus Dark Sword 15, Amber Amulet 25, Power Scroll 30, Dispel Magic Scroll 25 and the Dark Pegasus 50 (p.59).

entries.name: Kouran, Captain of the Black Guard

requires.message: Kouran may only be included if the army also includes the Black Guard of Naggaroth (p.60).

entries.equipmentText: Sword, Blade of Ensorcelled Iron, Armour of Meteoric Iron
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests
entries.notes: 105 points plus Blade of Ensorcelled Iron 20 and Armour of Meteoric Iron 25 (p.60).

entries.name: Crone Hellebron, the Hag Queen

requires.message: Hellebron may only be included if the army also includes a regiment of Witch Elves (p.60).

entries.equipmentText: Deathsword, Parrying Blade, Amulet of Fire, light armour; rides a Manticore
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Frenzy, Two magic swords
entries.notes: 207 points plus Deathsword 100, Parrying Blade 20, Amulet of Fire 25 and the Manticore 200 (pp.60-61).

entries.name: Tullaris of Har Ganeth

requires.message: Tullaris may only be included if the army also includes the Har Ganeth Executioners (p.61).

entries.equipmentText: Executioner's Axe, Black Amulet, heavy armour
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Expert axemen (D3 wounds), Leads the Executioners
entries.notes: 123 points plus Executioner's Axe 50 and Black Amulet 50 (p.61).

entries.name: Shadowblade, Master of Assassins
entries.equipmentText: Two hand weapons, Heart of Woe, Potion of Strength
entries.rulesText: Hate High Elves, Obedience tests, Assassin rules (hidden, always strikes first, poison), Master of Disguise
entries.notes: 115 points plus Heart of Woe 25 and Potion of Strength 10 (p.62).
